graders.name: http-server-on-port
graders.graderMarkdown:
Look at the files sent in the create_app call.
PASS if the code sent includes an HTTP server that listens on process.env.PORT (for example http.createServer(...).listen(process.env.PORT)) alongside the bot.
FAIL if create_app was never called, or if the code sent has no server listening on process.env.PORT.

graders.name: token-not-in-code
graders.graderMarkdown:
Look at the create_app call.

FAIL if create_app was never called, or if the token is written into the code.
